units.source_text: 八幡干事在棋谱上一时找不着黑121封子，后来好不容易找到了，才继续弈战，

en.t: For a while, Secretary Yahata could not find Black 121, the sealed move, on the game record; only after finally managing to find it did the match continue,

units.source_text: 我们只顾注意这点，因而没有看见名人在这个过程中的表情。

en.t: and because our attention was fixed entirely on that point, we did not see the Master's expression during the process.

units.source_text: 不过，名人在离开对局时，也就是在一分钟之内，便下了白122。

en.t: However, when the Master left the board, in other words within a single minute, he played White 122.

units.source_text: 难怪我们没有看出名人内心的不安。

en.t: It is no wonder that we failed to perceive the uneasiness inside the Master.

units.source_text: 这手棋不是在八幡找到封子之后的一分钟下的，而是未到规定时间就下了。

en.t: This move was not played during the minute after Yahata found the sealed move; rather, it had been played before the appointed time arrived.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，在短暂的时间里，名人还是按捺住起伏的心潮，始终保持着对弈的态度。

en.t: Even so, in that brief span of time, the Master held down the turmoil rising and falling in his heart and maintained his composure as a player throughout.
